This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of zafirlukast in patients with Breast Cancer undergoing mastectomy, with specific eligibility criteria related to pregnancy, organ function, and prior medication history.

This study in PHASE1 and PHASE2 is investigating the use of nebulized ketamine, dexmedetomidine, and midazolam in oncological children scheduled for bone marrow aspirate and biopsy, with inclusion criteria of physical status I and II and exclusion criteria including known allergies to the drugs, organ dysfunction, cardiac dysrhythmia, congenital heart disease, psychotropic medication use, and mental retardation.

This phase II trial for COPD patients will evaluate the efficacy of RPL554 suspension in improving lung function and symptoms, with specific inclusion criteria such as stable COPD, acceptable spirometry results, and smoking history, while excluding patients with severe COPD exacerbations, comorbidities like asthma or lung cancer, recent surgeries, and certain medication use.

This trial is investigating the use of pembrolizumab/quavonlimab in patients with advanced solid tumors across different phases, including dose escalation, dose confirmation for NSCLC and SCLC, efficacy expansion for melanoma, and coformulation phases, with specific eligibility and exclusion criteria outlined for each phase.

Phase II clinical trial for sar566658 in participants with measurable metastatic Triple Negative Breast Cancer, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria, including prior chemotherapy regimen requirements and restrictions on prior treatments, organ function, and medical conditions, such as peripheral neuropathy and corneal diseases.

This study in phase II is investigating the use of valproate and related drugs in individuals aged 19-65 with bipolar disorder and current depressive episode, excluding those with certain medical conditions, drug use, or allergies, and with specific icd-10 codes related to depression.

Phase II trial for SNX-5422 in patients with confirmed TP53 null type cancer, with specific eligibility and exclusion criteria including prior lines of therapy, performance score, laboratory assessments, and prohibitions on investigational agents and other anticancer drugs, among others.

This trial in PHASE1 and PHASE2 is investigating the use of [18f] fluciclovine for high-risk biopsy-proven treatment-naïve prostate adenocarcinoma patients with specific Gleason score and serum PSA criteria, excluding those with certain hematologic disorders, recurrent prostate adenocarcinoma, known metastases, or allergies to glucagon or gadolinium-based contrast.

This trial in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of pimavanserin in treating depression in adults with Parkinson's disease, with specific eligibility criteria including a clinical diagnosis of idiopathic Parkinson's disease, meeting criteria for depression, and being on a stable dose of anti-Parkinson's medication, while excluding those with certain medical conditions and prior exposure to pimavanserin.

This clinical trial in PHASE1 and PHASE2 is investigating the use of plerixafor in patients with Fanconi Anemia (icd_code: D6103), with specific eligibility criteria including age range, Lansky Index, and cell count requirements, while excluding patients with certain conditions and requiring negative pregnancy test results for women of childbearing age.

This phase II trial for metastatic castrate-resistant prostate cancer will evaluate the efficacy of abiraterone acetate, prednisone, radium-223 dichloride, cabazitaxel, carboplatin, and enzalutamide in patients meeting specific eligibility criteria, including confirmed adenocarcinoma of the prostate, ongoing androgen deprivation therapy, and certain laboratory values within normal ranges, while excluding patients with uncontrolled seizure disorder, recent cardiovascular events, or recent use of specific medications.

This trial in phases II and III is investigating the use of olanzapine, an antipsychotic agent, for advanced cancer patients with chronic nausea or vomiting, with specific eligibility and exclusion criteria outlined, and no specific icd-10 codes provided.

This study in Phase 2 is investigating the use of diprophos for treating sprains in adults over 18 years old with specific Eaton classification types and trauma criteria, excluding patients with certain age ranges, conditions, and allergies.

This study in Phase 2 focuses on evaluating the effectiveness of nabilone 0.25 mg in patients with Parkinson's Disease who meet specific eligibility criteria, including stable medication use and absence of certain exclusion criteria, such as previous nabilone use or certain medical conditions, with the icd-10 code G20C.

Phase II trial for talazoparib in early breast cancer patients with germline BRCA 1/2 mutations, HER2 negative status, and specific tumor criteria, excluding those with certain medical history, prior treatments, or contraindications.

This trial in phase II for metastatic breast cancer patients aims to evaluate the efficacy of estramustine and standard practice drugs in combination with everolimus, with specific eligibility criteria including prior treatments, ECOG status, hematological, hepatic, and renal functions, and exclusion criteria such as hypersensitivity to estramustine, brain metastases, and certain medical conditions.

Phase II trial testing letrozole 5 mg in healthy oocyte donors aged 18-35 with regular ovulatory cycles for IVF, excluding those with contraindications for ovarian stimulation, PCOS, allergy to the drug, recent IUD use, and specific adverse reactions, with no specified icd-10 codes.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of indacaterol maleate and indacaterol acetate in patients with asthma, focusing on specific eligibility criteria such as age, duration of asthma diagnosis, lung function tests, weight requirements, and exclusion criteria including contraindications to certain drugs, recent asthma exacerbations, and specific medical conditions.

This study in Phase 2 aims to investigate the use of fluoxetine in adult patients with epilepsy, focusing on eligibility criteria such as age, language proficiency, and contraceptive use, while excluding patients with certain psychiatric disorders, substance use issues, and medical conditions like hepatic or renal insufficiency.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of different doses of paracetamol and chloroprocaine HCl for short duration knee procedures in patients meeting specific eligibility criteria, while excluding those with contraindications such as neuromuscular diseases, chronic pain syndromes, and significant medical history that could interfere with the study outcomes.

This clinical trial in phase II is investigating the combination of azd6738 and olaparib for patients with small cell lung cancer (SCLC) that has progressed after first-line therapy, with specific eligibility criteria including provision of informed consent, age ≥20, specific disease progression criteria, performance status, life expectancy, and various laboratory parameters, while excluding patients with certain previous treatments, conditions, and medications.

This trial is investigating the drug FF-10101-01 in patients with refractory or relapsed acute myeloid leukemia (AML), with specific eligibility criteria including documented AML, FLT3 mutation for Phase 2a, ECOG performance status of 0 to 2, and various exclusion criteria such as acute promyelocytic leukemia and active infections.

This trial in phases II and III is investigating the use of ga-68 labeled psma-11 PET imaging in patients with biopsy-proven prostate adenocarcinoma who are planned for prostatectomy, assessing eligibility criteria such as intermediate to high-risk disease and exclusion criteria such as prior neoadjuvant treatments.

This trial is investigating the use of troriluzole in subjects with specific hereditary ataxias (SCA1, SCA2, SCA3, SCA6, SCA7, SCA8, SCA10) who meet certain eligibility criteria, including a minimum SARA score and ability to ambulate, while excluding those with certain medical conditions or high SARA scores.

This trial in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of Chinese herbal medication and omalizumab in treating food allergy in individuals meeting specific eligibility criteria, excluding those with contraindications such as certain chronic diseases, recent use of investigational drugs, or specific medication history.

This trial in phase II is investigating the efficacy of secukinumab, an IL-17 inhibitor, in treating refractory unilateral rotator cuff tendinopathy in patients aged 18 to 65, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria outlined, and no specific ICD-10 codes provided.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the efficacy of metronomic xelox and classic xelox in patients with histologically proven mCRC and unresectable metastases, with specific eligibility criteria including age range, performance status, lesion measurements, previous treatments, organ functions, and exclusion of patients with only ascites or bone metastasis.

This trial in phases PHASE1 and PHASE2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of oral testosterone undecanoate in males with hypogonadism, with strict eligibility criteria including specific age range, serum testosterone levels, and exclusion criteria such as certain medical conditions, drug use history, and lifestyle factors.

This trial in phase II is investigating the use of doxycycline 50mg tablet in combination with FOLFOX + anti-EGFR or FOLFIRI + anti-EGFR as first-line treatment for metastatic colorectal cancer in patients with wild-type RAS tumor status, with specific eligibility and exclusion criteria outlined.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the combination of pembrolizumab and capecitabine for patients with histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the rectum, with specific eligibility and exclusion criteria outlined, aiming to assess the efficacy and safety of this treatment regimen.

Phase II trial for prostate cancer using 18f-dcfpyl PET/CT drug with eligibility criteria including previous diagnosis of prostate cancer, ECOG performance status 0-3, and ability to tolerate physical requirements of PET/CT scan.

This study in Phase 2 is investigating the use of caphosol and 0.9% NaCl in pediatric cancer patients aged 2-17.99 years old with solid or hematological malignancies undergoing specific mucosa-breaking chemotherapeutic regimens, excluding patients with mucositis at the start of treatment or undergoing stem cell transplantation.

Phase II trial for metastatic colorectal cancer testing combination therapy with irinotecan, oxaliplatin, levoleucovorin, 5-FU, GM-CSF, and IL-2, with strict eligibility criteria including age, performance status, and laboratory requirements, while excluding patients with previous chemotherapy, cardiac issues, infections, and certain diseases.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the combination of fulvestrant with enzalutamide for ER+ Her2- metastatic breast cancer patients, with specific eligibility criteria including the need for ovarian suppression in pre- or peri-menopausal subjects and exclusion criteria such as prior treatment with anti-androgens.

This trial in phases I and II is investigating the use of [131]i-iaza in patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors, with specific eligibility criteria including age, tumor size, liver function, blood counts, kidney function, ECOG performance score, and exclusion criteria such as recent systemic therapy, radiation therapy to the only evaluable lesion, and certain medical conditions.

This study in PHASE2 for Breast Cancer patients will evaluate the use of liposomal bupivacaine, bupivacaine, patient-controlled analgesia pump, and oral narcotic for pain management in patients undergoing unilateral, immediate breast reconstruction, with specific eligibility criteria and no specified icd-10 codes.

This phase II trial is investigating the efficacy of tomivosertib (eft-508) in patients with solid tumors who have progressed on anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 therapy, with specific eligibility criteria including adequate organ function, negative viral serology, and specific exclusion criteria such as active infections or autoimmune disorders.
